description: Use obligations in the Land category for Land Expenses, including inherited _category labels, creditor details and scheduled monthly amounts.

namedFunction.name: LAND_EXPENSES_D
namedFunction.definition:
=LET(
  source, S_OBLIGATIONS,
  categories, COL_VALUES(source, "_category"),
  names, COL_VALUES(source, "name"),
  creditors, COL_VALUES(source, "creditor"),
  values, CHOOSECOLS(DATA_ROWS(source), MATCH(m, HEADER_ROW(source), 0)),
  IFNA(
    FILTER(
      HSTACK(categories, names, creditors, values),
      ARRAYFORMULA(LOWER(TRIM(categories))="land"),
      names<>"",
      ISNUMBER(values),
      values>0
    ),
    {"","","",""}
  )
)
namedFunction.appliedVia: Existing Google Sheets named-function editor; retains LAND_EXPENSES_D(m) calls in Details.

notes: The source is S_OBLIGATIONS with _category matching Land (case-insensitive, trimmed).
Retain existing positive-amount detail behavior. Totals and non-Land categories are excluded.
Details A6 formula and period/type dropdowns are unchanged.
Add three formatted rows so the combined all-period output of 88 rows fits.
Temporary test sheet removed; live Land view visually verified.
No Apps Script source change is needed; the named-function update is saved directly in the spreadsheet.
